transcript: I spent $150,000 on this degree. Was it worth it? I don't think so. I've worked at a Big Four and a Fortune 500 company as a senior data analyst. Neither one cared about my degree. They only cared if I could actually do the work. And the skills that actually got me hired, I didn't learn them in classroom. Yes, university gave me network, friends, and the exposure, but DataCamp gave me the part that actually got me paid. SQL, Python, Tableau, or Power BI. Like real statistics, not just theory. And the best part? All 600+ DataCamp courses are free from June 1st to June 7th, including career tracks and certifications. Like there is something for everyone, no matter what your goals: data analytics, data science, business intelligence, and machine learning. Or if you just want to learn to code, you can enroll in these free tracks. And all without putting in your credit card. Enrollments are closing soon, so comment DataCamp to get the link.
